name: airo-doffy-baselines-parallel-c11-bs32
description: Parallel batch-size-32 training of original_dp, dp_beaver, fm, and fm_beaver on 1x H200 with 16 CPUs, W&B, and HF uploads

command: set -Eeuo pipefail; stage_dir=/tmp/airo_baseline_cluster11_stage; ready_file=${stage_dir}/READY; echo 'Waiting for authenticated source/data staging...'; for stage_attempt in $(seq 1 900); do if [ -f "${ready_file}" ]; then exec bash "${stage_dir}/run-baseline-policies-parallel-cluster11-bs32.sh"; fi; sleep 2; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for staged inputs' >&2; exit 2
